extracted.intended_audience: readers of The Spectator / polite society (particularly women seeking reading and conduct advice)
extracted.subtask_description: Prescriptive advice (in essay form) on how persons — especially women — should fill idle hours, choose books for a lady's library, and cultivate conversation, arts, and study to improve life. Includes recommended types of reading and methods for personal improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exercise of virtue (social virtues) as employment
rubrics_metrics.description: The first is the Exercise of Virtue, in the most general Acceptation of the Word.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Social virtues provide constant employment: advise the ignorant, relieve the needy, comfort the afflicted; mitigate party fierceness; do justice to deserving characters; soften the envious, quiet the angry, rectify the prejudiced. These are everyday duties suited to reasonable nature and bring satisfaction when done with discretion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Religious intercourse / habitual sense of the divine presence
rubrics_metrics.description: Intercourse and Communication which every reasonable Creature ought to maintain with the great Author of his Being.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintaining a habitual sense of the Divine Presence keeps up cheerfulness, prevents loneliness, and fills idle hours with devotion, hope, and consolation. The man conscious of God's presence never finds time heavy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Useful and innocent diversions (but avoid mere gaming)
rubrics_metrics.description: The next Method... should be useful and innocent Diversions. I think it is below reasonable Creatures to be altogether conversant in such Diversions as are meerly innocent... Whether any kind of Gaming has even thus much to say for it self, I shall not determine;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allow diversions that are innocent and useful, but criticises the wastefulness of excessive gaming (e.g., spending hours shuffling cards with no intellectual content). Choose entertainments that engage the mind beyond trivial play.

rubrics_metrics.name: The stage/theatre as a source of noble, regulated entertainment
rubrics_metrics.description: The Stage might be made a perpetual Source of the most noble and useful Entertainments, were it under proper Regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Theatre can provide elevated and useful amusement if subject to appropriate regulation; supports drama and plays as a legitimate resource for spending leisure well when reformed or managed properly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversation with a well-chosen friend
rubrics_metrics.description: The Mind never unbends itself so agreeably as in the Conversation of a well chosen Friend.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Good intimate friendship eases and unloads the mind, clears and improves the understanding, engenders thoughts and knowledge, animates virtue and resolution, soothes passions, and provides employment for vacant hours; value discretion and virtue in friends.

rubrics_metrics.name: General conversation with improving companions
rubrics_metrics.description: One would endeavour after a more general Conversation with such as are able to entertain and improve those with whom they converse, which are Qualifications that seldom go asunder.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seek out broader social conversation with people who educate and entertain — chosen company should both amuse and improve the mind.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultivate arts and practical hobbies (music, painting, architecture, gardening)
rubrics_metrics.description: A Man that has a Taste of Musick, Painting, or Architecture, is like one that has another Sense when compared with such as have no Relish of those Arts. The Florist, the Planter, the Gardiner, the Husbandman... are great Reliefs to a Country Life, and many ways useful
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acquire artistic tastes and practical country pursuits as accomplishments that enrich life, provide relief in leisure, and give additional modes of perception and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reading useful and entertaining authors to fill idle hours
rubrics_metrics.description: But of all the Diversions of Life, there is none so proper to fill up its empty Spaces as the reading of useful and entertaining Authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritise reading that is both useful and entertaining to occupy vacant time productively; reading overlaps with and supports the broader pursuit of knowledge.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pursuit of knowledge / sustained study as lifelong employment
rubrics_metrics.description: Employing ourselves in the Pursuit of Knowledge... there is not a single Science, or any Branch of it, that might not furnish a Man with Business for Life
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Devote time to study and learning: any science or branch of knowledge can provide a lifetime of engagement; study lengthens perceived life and provides deep occupation beyond transient amusements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep a rapid succession of ideas to lengthen perceived time
rubrics_metrics.description: We get the Idea of Time by reflecting on that Train of Ideas which succeed one another in our Minds... one who fixes his Thoughts very intently on one thing... thinks that Time shorter than it is. Conversely, entertaining a quick and constant Succession of Ideas lengthens perceived life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cultivate varied, rapid intellectual engagement (many distinct ideas) to make life feel fuller and longer; study and diverse pursuits increase the succession of ideas and thus the apparent duration of life (supported by Locke and Mallebranche examples).

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection criteria for a Lady's Library
rubrics_metrics.description: In recommending books for women: avoid nailing Women upon their Knees with Manuals of Devotion, nor of scorching their Faces with Books of Housewifry; Plays of all Sorts have their several Advocates... 'All for Love' and 'Theodosius' recommended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose books for ladies that suit taste and improvement rather than only devotional manuals or household guides; include plays, histories, and literature (classics and dramatic works), and works that make women 'general Scholars' (e.g., Bayle). Consider correspondents' diverse recommendations (booksellers, husbands, women, men of learning).

rubrics_metrics.name: Approach to compiling a Lady's Library: examine, adapt, proceed cautiously
rubrics_metrics.description: I shall defer the executing of it till I am further acquainted with the Thoughts of my judicious Contemporaries, and have time to examine the several Books they offer to me; being resolved, in an Affair of this Moment, to proceed with the greatest Caution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When assembling a recommended library, examine suggested works carefully, take counsel from knowledgeable readers, and adapt selected passages from best authors to the ladies' taste; do not rush the compilation.
